# parity-fuzz --mode typeset baseline: normalized signatures of KNOWN gaps.
# A divergence whose signature is here is allowed; a NEW one fails CI.
# Regenerate: parity-fuzz --mode typeset --count N --verify 3  (copy NEW-signature lines).
#
# EMPTY — the mode has no allowed gaps. Every divergence fails.
#
# It used to carry four signatures for `typeset -l` / `-u` (docs/BUGS.md
# #1019): the fold was applied at ASSIGNMENT, so the original text was gone
# and `typeset +l` handed back the folded value. Three sites were wrong at
# once, which is why partial attempts kept regressing a different case:
#   - `setstrvalue` (params.rs) folded on store; C's setstrvalue
#     (c:Src/params.c:2677) has no case arm at all.
#   - `bin_typeset`'s scalar-assign arm folded before `assignsparam`.
#   - `bin_typeset`'s attribute arm treated PM_LOWER / PM_UPPER as type
#     conversions and re-stored the value it had just read back FOLDED, so
#     even a correct read fold could not have restored the original.
# The fold now lives where C puts it: `getstrvalue`'s VALFLAG_SUBST tail
# (c:2497-2506) and `getsparam` (zshrs's substitution-read path, which
# already inlined that block's justify padding), plus `copyenvstr` (c:5434)
# for the env mirror. `chflags` (c:2117) decides what counts as a type
# conversion, and the case bits are not in it.
#
# The generator arm was widened at the same time, because the old one could
# not have caught the other half of the bug: it only assigned AFTER removing
# the attribute, never exported, and drew from an ASCII-only value pool. It
# now probes the live-attribute assignment, the `-x` env mirror, and a pool
# with widening case mappings (`ß`, `ﬁ`, titlecase digraphs) that reaches
# `casemodify` through `${(U)}` / `${(L)}` / `${(C)}` / `:u` / `:l`.
#
# Any divergence at all is a regression.
